en.batchAddedNone: Nothing new: all {duplicates} key(s) are already in the pool.
en.batchHint: One key per line. Surrounding whitespace is ignored; blank lines and duplicates are skipped.
en.batchRemoveHint: Tick the keys to remove. Removal cannot be undone: a key goes away together with its stats and balance.
en.budgetFromConstant: Each call budgets {budget}ms from this plugin's own constant: the host timeout bound to this tool could not be read.
en.capabilityHint: DSH is in preview and its plugin interfaces change between releases; see docs/dsh-upgrade.md.
en.capabilityMissing: The host is missing {count} capability(ies) this plugin uses: {list}
en.classificationAuth: authentication failed — store a different key
en.classificationExhausted: quota exhausted — resets on the 1st, or raise the limit in the dashboard
en.classificationQuota: the local refresh quota for this key is exhausted (10 calls per 600s); try again later
en.classificationRateLimited: rate limited upstream — try again later
en.description: Runs web_search and web_fetch through Tavily: multiple keys, balance-aware scheduling, automatic failover, call history.
en.empty: No keys yet. Keys are added here only; this plugin never reads environment variables.
en.fallbackInvalid: Credential no longer valid. The official provider rejected it (HTTP 401/403); store a new one.
en.fallbackMissing: Credential not configured. Turning the toggle off will fail — configure the official credential in the Models page or the environment first.
en.fetchDepthHint: Every 5 successful URLs cost 1 credit (advanced costs 2); failed URLs are never charged.
en.fetchFormatHint: markdown is the official default; text adds latency.
en.fetchToggleHint: When off, fetching goes to DSH's built-in local HTTP fetcher. Independent of the search toggle.
en.historyEmpty: No calls recorded in the last {days} days.
en.historyError: The history file could not be read: {message} (calls are unaffected, but this chart is empty)
en.historyHint: Calls over the last {days} days, bucketed by local date.
en.includeAnswerHint: Ask Tavily for a generated answer returned as the result content.
en.keyAlreadyInPool: That key is already in the pool; nothing was added.
en.manualOrderHint: The policy is manual, so this list is the scheduling order.
en.maxResultsInvalid: Results must be an integer between ${MAX_RESULTS_MIN} and ${MAX_RESULTS_MAX}.
en.poolError: The key pool file could not be read: {message}
en.poolErrorFix: Fix or remove that file to recover; until then search falls back to the official provider.
en.schedulingPolicyHint: balance: highest remaining balance first, rotating within a tier.
en.schedulingPolicyManualHint: manual: try keys strictly in the order listed below, ignoring balance; that list becomes the scheduling order.
en.searchDepthHint: advanced costs 2 credits per call; the other three cost 1.
en.searchToggleHint: When off, search goes to the DSH official provider. Saving applies immediately; no restart.
en.title: Tavily key pool
